output.summary: The user requires a >= 20% decrease in safety incidents per 10,000 service miles. Last year's rate was 38 incidents / 120,000 miles = 3.167 per 10k miles. This year's rate is 28 incidents / 135,000 miles = 2.074 per 10k miles. The percentage decrease is (3.167 - 2.074) / 3.167 ≈ 34.5%. Since 34.5% > 20%, the constraint is satisfied. The executive summary's claim of a 26% drop in total incidents is consistent with the raw counts (38 to 28 is a ~26.3% drop), but the per-mile metric is the deciding factor, which also passes.
key_claims: Last year's incident rate: 3.167 per 10,000 miles
